newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila 8-mth exports up 16.3 pct to $13.034 bln.
newsitem.headline: Manila 8-mth exports up 16.3 pct to $13.034 bln.

text.p: The Philippines' merchandise export receipts from January to August rose 16.3 percent to $13.034 billion from $11.207 billion in the first eight months of 1995, the government said on Wednesday.
The National Statistics Office (NSO) said revenue from exports for the month of August grew by 10.4 percent to $1.758 billion from $1.591 billion in the same month last year.
In August, the star performer was electronics and components with receipts of $652.92 million accounting for 37.1 percent of total exports for the month.
Apparel and clothing accessories brought in $229.33 million, or 13 percent of August receipts.
The NSO did not say which sectors brought in the most revenue in the eight months from January to August.
